Since the refactoring tools are not available, I'll proceed to write a test that mocks the ILogger and verifies that LogInformation is called at line 333. To do this, I need to identify the class that contains the method calling LogInformation, which appears to be the SuiteCommand class, specifically in the ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand method.

I'll create a test that instantiates SuiteCommand, injects a mock ILogger, and calls ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand, then verifies that LogInformation was called with the expected message.

I'll start by reading the namespace and class declaration to prepare the test file.

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand_LogsCorrectMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
                null, null, null, null, null, null)
            {
                Logger = mockLogger.Object
            };

            // Act
            suiteCommand.GetType()
                .GetMethod("ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                .Invoke(suiteCommand, null);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation("You can also run the following command to install ABP Suite."),
                Times.Once);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation("dotnet tool install -g Volo.Abp.Suite --add-source https://nuget.abp.io/<your-private-key>/v3/index.json"),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand_LogsCorrectMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
                null, null, null, null, null, null)
            {
                Logger = mockLogger.Object
            };

            // Act
            suiteCommand.GetType()
                .GetMethod("ShowSuiteManualInstallCommand", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                .Invoke(suiteCommand, null);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("You can also run the following command to install ABP Suite.")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("dotnet tool install -g Volo.Abp.Suite --add-source https://nuget.abp.io/<your-private-key>/v3/index.json")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
